query: UPDATE step_permission p SET status = 'answered', option_id = $2, answered_by = $3, answered_box = $4, answered_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.status = 'pending' AND p.options @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id', $2::text)) AND p.owner = (SELECT r.lease_owner FROM run r WHERE r.id = p.run_id AND r.lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp())
